meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会调试一个具体的 LazyCodex 或 Codex 缺陷，在临时工作区写最小修复，并附上复现日志和验证日志交付。上游 openai/codex 的缺陷开 fork PR；LazyCodex 自身的缺陷提交 verified-fix issue，不开 PR。
howto.when: 当你要求修复某个 bug、提交 bug 修复、为 bug 开 PR，或调试 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时触发。

say.text: 帮我修这个 LazyCodex bug，带上复现和验证日志
say.note: 会提交 verified-fix issue，不开 PR

say.text: 给这个上游 openai/codex bug 开一个 fork PR
say.note: 先复现，再把分支推到你的 fork

say.text: 先复现这个缺陷，判断它归 LazyCodex 还是上游 Codex
say.note: 会比较两边源码后决定目标仓库

howto.what_en: Claude debugs a concrete LazyCodex or Codex defect in a fresh temp workspace, writes the smallest fix, and delivers it with repro and verification logs. Upstream openai/codex bugs become a fork PR; LazyCodex defects become an issue.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex bug with reproduction and verification logs
say_en.note: Files a verified-fix issue on lazycodex, never a PR

say_en.text: Open a fork PR for this upstream openai/codex bug
say_en.note: Reproduces first, then pushes the branch to your fork

say_en.text: Reproduce this defect and determine which repo owns it
say_en.note: Compares LazyCodex and upstream Codex sources
